bioEn: Mr. Zhang is leading the newly established Agriculture, Food, Nature, and Rural Development (AFNR) Sector Office at the Asian Development Bank. bio: 夏泽翰教授，联合国教科文组织东亚地区办事处主任，负责中国、朝鲜、日本、蒙古和韩国的项目和工作。2008年加入联合国教科文组织，曾在总部担任水资源与可持续发展处主任，后在印尼雅加达任亚太科学局主任及驻多国代表。曾在澳大利亚、法国、印尼和巴基斯坦从事研究、咨询与政策工作。
bioEn: Professor Shahbaz Khan is the Director of the UNESCO Multisectoral Regional Office for East Asia, overseeing projects and operations in China, North Korea, Japan, Mongolia, and South Korea. He joined UNESCO in 2008, serving as the Director of the Water Resources and Sustainable Development Division at headquarters, and later as the Director and Representative of the Asia-Pacific Science Bureau in Jakarta. He has also worked in research, consulting, and policy roles in Australia, France, Indonesia, and Pakistan.

name: 石岚
title: 教育专家
bio: 石岚是中国教育三十人论坛的成员，专注于教育政策与改革的研究。她在教育领域有着丰富的经验，致力于推动教育公平与质量提升。石岚曾参与多个国家级教育项目，积极倡导创新教育模式。
bioEn: Lan Shi is a member of the China Education Thirty Forum, focusing on research in education policy and reform. She has extensive experience in the education sector and is committed to promoting educational equity and quality improvement. Lan has participated in several national education projects and actively advocates for innovative educational models.

name: Bernice Lee
title: 杰出研究员兼高级顾问
bio: Bernice Lee 是查塔姆研究所的杰出研究员兼高级顾问，专注于气候变化政治、可持续创新、资源安全、国际贸易和中国事务。她曾担任世界经济论坛气候变化与资源安全项目总监，以及查塔姆研究所能源、环境与资源部门、全球经济与金融项目和霍夫曼可持续资源经济中心的总监。她还曾在联合国秘书长办公室、洛克菲勒基金会和阿迦汗基金会（英国）工作，并在儿童投资基金会气候变化咨询委员会和壳牌外部评审委员会等机构任职。2011年，她因在气候变化合作方面的贡献被授予大英帝国官佐勋章（OBE）。她的研究成果曾被《金融时报》、《纽约时报》、《连线》、《彭博社》、《华尔街日报》、《外交事务》、《财经》、《哈佛商业评论》和《美洲季刊》等媒体报道。
bioEn: Bernice Lee is a Distinguished Fellow and Senior Advisor at Chatham House, specializing in the politics of climate change, innovation for sustainability, resource security, international trade, and China. She has previously served as Director of Climate Change and Resource Security Initiatives at the World Economic Forum, and as Director of Chatham House's Energy, Environment and Resources Department, Global Economy and Finance Programme, and the Hoffmann Centre for Sustainable Resource Economy. She has also held positions at the UN Secretary-General's office, the Rockefeller Foundation, and the Aga Khan Foundation (UK), and served on the Children's Investment Fund Foundation's Climate Change Advisory Board and Shell's External Review Committee. In 2011, she was awarded an OBE for her contributions to climate change cooperation. Her work has been covered in the Financial Times, New York Times, Wired, Bloomberg, Wall Street Journal, Foreign Affairs, Caijing, Harvard Business Review, and the Americas Quarterly.

He has extensive experience in the field of sustainable infrastructure and is committed to addressing the challenges faced by global infrastructure.

bio: 马军，知名环保人士、学者、作家。1993年起在《南华早报》工作，期间研究中国环境问题，并于1999年出版专著《中国水危机》。2006年创立公众环境研究中心（IPE），致力于推动环境信息公开和企业绿色供应链管理，建立了中国第一个公益性环境信息数据库“中国水污染地图”。
bioEn: Ma Jun is a renowned environmentalist, scholar, and writer. Starting in 1993, he worked at the South China Morning Post, researching China's environmental issues and publishing the book "China's Water Crisis" in 1999. In 2006, he founded the Institute of Public and Environmental Affairs (IPE), focusing on promoting environmental information transparency and corporate green supply chain management, and established China's first public environmental information database, the "China Water Pollution Map."

Since 2011, he has served as CEO and President of Geely Automobile Group, leading the team to achieve systematic improvements in design, R&D, manufacturing, quality, marketing, and service, winning the domestic brand passenger car sales championship for four consecutive years. In 2013, he obtained an Executive MBA from Tsinghua University.
